overview.Name: Momentus Inc.
overview.Description: Momentus Inc. operates as a commercial space company in the United States. The company offers satellites, satellite buses, solar arrays, and other satellite components; transportation, communication, and infrastructure services, including hosted payloads, and other in-orbit services for government and commercial customers. It serves satellite operators. The company is based in San Jose, California.
